home.workflowSubtitle: A simple four-step flow from selecting a plot to reviewing a risk summary.

select.title: Select the land
select.body: Choose division, district, upazila and mouza, then enter the survey type, khatian and dag number.

seller.title: Enter seller claims
seller.body: Record the ownership, share and sale area as claimed by the seller.

verify.title: Run the check
verify.body: The platform compares the seller claim against the recorded land data and lists findings.

decide.title: Review and decide
decide.body: Review each finding and the overall risk level, then generate an informational report.

home.riskSubtitle: Each check contributes to an overall risk level that summarises what the recorded data suggests.

riskDescriptions.LOW_CONCERN: The recorded data is consistent with the seller claim; no significant inconsistencies were found.
riskDescriptions.REVIEW_REQUIRED: Some records differ or are missing. Verify these points with the relevant office before proceeding.
riskDescriptions.HIGH_ATTENTION: Multiple or serious inconsistencies were found. Proceed only after careful verification.
riskDescriptions.CRITICAL_SIGNAL: Critical inconsistencies such as ownership mismatch or conflicting records were found. Seek professional advice.
riskDescriptions.INSUFFICIENT_DATA: Not enough recorded data is available to complete a meaningful review for this selection.

home.beforeYouBuySubtitle: A short checklist of the most important points to confirm before a land transaction.

checklist.khatian: Confirm the khatian (record of rights) matches the seller.
checklist.dag: Confirm the dag number and total area match the plot offered.
checklist.ownership: Check all recorded owners and their shares, especially for joint ownership.
checklist.mutation: Check whether name transfer (mutation) is approved or still pending.
checklist.cases: Look for legal case signals, government/khas status and acquisition notices.

landGuide.title: Land Buying Guide
landGuide.subtitle: A step-by-step checklist citizens can follow before buying land in Bangladesh.
landGuide.notice: These checks help identify potential inconsistencies before proceeding. They do not guarantee that a transaction is safe, and they are not legal advice.

steps.title: Confirm the land identity
steps.body: Identify the district, upazila, mouza, survey type, khatian number and dag number of the plot you intend to buy. Mismatched identifiers are the most common source of confusion.

steps.title: Check the khatian (record of rights)
steps.body: Obtain the current khatian and confirm the recorded owner names match the seller. Check whether the khatian is RS, SA, BS or CS and whether a later survey supersedes it.

steps.title: Verify the dag and area
steps.body: Confirm the dag number and total area in decimal. Compare the area offered for sale against the recorded area of the plot.

steps.title: Review recorded ownership and share
steps.body: Check all recorded owners and their shares. If land is jointly owned, ensure every owner (or a lawful representative) is part of the transaction.

steps.title: Review mutation (name transfer) status
steps.body: Check whether mutation has been applied for and approved. Pending mutation can indicate that ownership has not yet been updated in the record.

steps.title: Review inheritance / succession records
steps.body: If the land was inherited, check whether a succession record exists and whether the recorded share is consistent with the declared heirs.

steps.title: Check for legal cases and government status
steps.body: Look for pending or resolved cases, disputes, acquisition notices and government or khas land status that could affect the plot.

steps.title: Review transaction and registration history
steps.body: Review past sale deeds and registration history. An unregistered deed does not transfer legal title, and overlapping sale claims are a warning sign.

steps.title: Confirm with official sources before paying
steps.body: Before paying or registering, confirm documents with the relevant land office and, where needed, a qualified legal professional. Keep receipts and official copies.
